description: Builds the El Carot tarot-interpretation prompt (voseo ES / warm EN) for a drawn card + the user's question, embedding the base meaning and the tone/length constraints.
name: buildInterpretPrompt

description: Build a direct, shareable URL to a card's reading, e.g. `https://elcarot.app/reading?n=0`. Pure — `baseUrl` is injected so this is unit-testable without a browser. No `origin` query is added: a recipient should land on a clean reading whose Back button goes home.
name: buildReadingUrl

description: The text shown in the native share sheet: character, arcana, and quote. Pure.
name: buildShareText

description: Formats a card number as "arcana · name" for the stats tables, degrading to "#n" for an out-of-range index.
name: cardLabel

untestabilityReason.justification: A CAROT_CARDS index lookup with a fallback string; presentational formatting verifiable by inspection.

description: Resolves a card's meaning or quote in the active language, falling back to the Spanish source text when an English variant is missing.
name: cardText

description: Compose a portrait phone wallpaper for a card. Returns a PNG Blob, or null if compositing fails. Guarded by a timeout so a stuck `toBlob` can never hang the caller (e.g. the download button's busy state).
name: composeWallpaper

description: Centre a card of aspect `ratio` (width / height) inside a `canvasW × canvasH` frame, occupying `widthFraction` of the width but never taller than `maxHeightFraction` of the height. Pure → unit-testable without a canvas.
name: computeCardRect

description: Deterministic card-of-the-day index: hashes the local Y/M/D into a deck position so the whole calendar day shows the same card.
name: dailyCardIndex

description: Sniffs the Accept-Language header for a Spanish locale, defaulting to English when the header is absent. The last fallback in the middleware's language chain.
name: detectFromAcceptLanguage

untestabilityReason.justification: A null guard plus one regex test against a module constant; verifiable by inspection.

description: Compose the wallpaper and trigger a download. Returns true on success.
name: downloadWallpaper

description: Formats a timestamp as "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM UTC" for the stats tables.
name: fmt

untestabilityReason.justification: A single toISOString slice; presentational formatting verifiable by inspection.

description: Formats the drawn date for the daily badge in the active language (ES long form / EN month-day form).
name: formatDailyDate

description: Formats a comment's ISO timestamp as a zero-padded DD.MM.YYYY date.
name: formatDate

untestabilityReason.justification: Zero-pads three Date getters into a template string; presentational formatting verifiable by inspection.

description: Reads the coarse geo fields (country, region, timezone) Vercel injects on the incoming request. Never touches the IP or precise location; every field is null off-Vercel.
name: geoFromHeaders

description: The card of the day: one card per UTC calendar day, the same for everyone. The first draw picks it deterministically and persists it; later draws read the stored row. Falls back to the deterministic pick if the database is unavailable.
name: getDailyCardN

untestabilityReason.justification: A DailyCard findUnique/create round-trip; the deterministic pick it falls back to is lib/daily.ts::dailyCardIndex, covered by lib/daily.test.ts.

description: Load a same-origin image via a plain `` (the way the reading page loads card art). No `crossOrigin` is set: same-origin images never taint the canvas, so `getImageData`/`toBlob` stay allowed. A timeout rejects rather than hangs if the image never fires load/error.
name: loadImage

description: Best-effort logging of an asked question with its drawn card and coarse geo — swallows every error so logging can never block or break the interpretation reply.
name: logQuestion

untestabilityReason.justification: A bare prisma.question.create in a try/catch; the work IS the database write.

description: Entry point of the database seed script. Currently the untouched project-template stub — it seeds nothing and only prints a reminder to add models.
name: main

untestabilityReason.justification: Untouched seed-script stub from the project template; it has no seeding logic to test yet.

description: Picks N distinct random cards (Fisher–Yates over deck indices, clamped to [0, deck.length]) for the Home fan illustration. RNG is injectable for deterministic tests.
name: pickFan

description: Joins the coarse geo fields into one display string — "country / region · timezone" — for the stats tables, showing an em dash when nothing is known.
name: place

untestabilityReason.justification: A filter/join of three optional strings; presentational formatting verifiable by inspection.

description: Render the wallpaper into a 1080×1920 canvas: the card art centred on a background of its own frame colour, with generous margin all around. Returns the canvas, or null if a 2D context isn't available.
name: renderWallpaperCanvas

description: Read the card's frame colour by sampling a pixel just inside its top edge (the aged-cream border). Returns an `rgb(...)` string, or the cream token if the image can't be sampled (e.g. a tainted canvas).
name: sampleFrameColor

description: Share a reading. On devices with the Web Share API (mobile) this opens the native sheet; otherwise (most desktops) it copies the direct link to the clipboard. Returns what actually happened so the caller can show feedback.
name: shareReading

description: Hook exposing the active language and its translated strings to any client component under CarotProvider.
name: useCarot

untestabilityReason.justification: A one-line React.useContext re-export; the behaviour under test lives in CarotProvider.

description: matchMedia hook — true when the viewport is at least minWidth px; mobile-first/SSR-safe.

description: Hook exposing the shared star-menu open/close state, so the mobile toggle and the desktop in-nav star drive the same menu.
name: useMenu

untestabilityReason.justification: A one-line React.useContext re-export; the behaviour under test lives in MenuProvider.

description: UTC calendar-day key, YYYY-MM-DD — the identity of "the card of the day", so every visitor worldwide shares one card per UTC day.
